system.description:
Your bonded weapon is more than a tool: it is a partner, more attuned to you with every spell channelled through it.

  • Attuned Edge: your bonded weapon counts as magical for overcoming damage resistance. If it is lost or destroyed, you may bond a replacement of the same type after a 1-hour ritual at no cost.
    • 9th level: your Cantrip Spellstrikes through it ignore resistance to force damage.
  • Bonded Lore: Advantage on checks to identify weapons and the magic in them.
